auditChanges: cfb TCU @ Texas Tech: Ledger SKIP (qb-close) -> PICK Texas Tech "lean". The stored away QB was wrong - Jaden Craig is out with an ankle injury and Adam Schobel starts, with a season passer efficiency of 62.2 (15-of-32, 106 yds, 0 TD, 2 INT), not Craig's 137.9. The QB gap is therefore 73.5 in Texas Tech's favor, so SCREEN 2 no longer vetoes on qb-close and the PD/g gap of 8.7 sets the "lean" tier. Second Opinion gains Injuries/Lineup for Texas Tech (tally 2-1 -> 3-1) and remains a pass.

games.altBlowoutCheck: Neither team's most recent game was a win by 17+ points (TCU lost its last game 38-17 at home to Utah; Texas Tech won by 10 at Baylor), so the blowout-win regression check does not apply to either side this week.

Form: Texas Tech 3-0 in last 3 (beat West Virginia 53-48, Oklahoma State 52-27, Baylor 20-10) vs TCU 1-2 in last 3 (28-29 loss at Arizona, beat Kansas State 20-10, 38-17 home loss to Utah) favors Texas Tech

Motivation/Spot: TCU needs one win for bowl eligibility at 5-6 and plays spoiler on Thanksgiving night under interim head coach Andy Avalos after Sonny Dykes was fired Sunday (classic trap spot), though Texas Tech is playing for a Big 12 Championship Game berth of its own, favors TCU
